entries.problem: R162 described exact Bonferroni Student coverage under complete non-degenerate Gaussian W_i while the same observed W_i was defined in [-1,1]^8. Those exact premises are jointly satisfiable only in the degenerate zero-covariance case.
entries.effective_correction: R162's planwise premise and tower-property transport theorem remain valid. Exact Gaussian Student intervals no longer count as a non-degenerate exact discharge for observed bounded W. R163:HOEFFDING_PLANWISE_COVERAGE supplies the exact bounded observed-target discharge; Gaussian Student calculations are approximate or latent-model scenarios only.
entries.downstream_rule_effect: No inherited rule is deleted. Any use of r162_independent_freeze_coverage for observed bounded W must provide R163 bounded planwise coverage or another separately proved planwise family.
